proposals.citation: pattanaik-koul2003varli[p. 85, item 282, Davar Varli];CDIAL[8209 and addenda]
proposals.evidence: Turner8209 gives Pali pivati, Prakrit pi(v)ai and western continuations Gujarati pīvũ, Marathi piṇẽ. The survey piva/pi contrast belongs to this retained-v versus contracted drinking stem series; retain source vowel lengths as printed.

assignments.Source: pattanaik-koul2003varli[p. 85, item 282, Davar Varli];CDIAL[8209 and addenda]
assignments.Notes: Turner8209 gives Pali pivati, Prakrit pi(v)ai and western continuations Gujarati pīvũ, Marathi piṇẽ. The survey piva/pi contrast belongs to this retained-v versus contracted drinking stem series; retain source vowel lengths as printed. Varli unextended eating/drinking stems; unresolved morphology retained; no rebuild.

proposals.citation: pattanaik-koul2003varli[p. 85, item 283, Davar Varli];CDIAL[3865 and addenda]
proposals.evidence: Turner3865 section1 gives the khā- eating stem with Gujarati khāvũ, Marathi khāṇẽ and Konkani khāuṁk. The unextended source kha eat is assigned here; no causative, passive or past-participle branch is inferred.
